text: Ituri bed capacity is flat this cycle and the SitRep66 outlier is now confirmed retrospectively. Ituri bed capacity across SitRep62-68 reads 693, 693, 700, 706, 798, 709, 708, and occupancy 79.2%, 78.1%, 78.3%, 76.3%, 69.3%, 78.4%, 78.5%. SitRep68's 708 sits one bed below SitRep67's 709 and is essentially the value SitRep66's 798 spike should have printed (the value that would have made the series monotonic and printed a ~78% occupancy in line with every neighbour), so two consecutive on-trend cycles now bracket the 798 outlier and confirm it as a single-cycle data-entry slip. There is no capacity story in Ituri this cycle: occupancy holds its ~78% plateau (78.4% -> 78.5%) and national capacity is flat (850 -> 849 beds). Nord-Kivu's 129.1% (182/141) remains the one genuine saturation. Recovered advanced +24 to 506 DRC cumulative (Ituri 23, Nord-Kivu 1), against 23 deaths and 35 non-case exits over the same 24 hours; country-scope recovered 517 with the 11 Uganda anchor.

text: 63 new confirmed cases (Ituri 46, Nord-Kivu 12, Haut-Uele 5) and 34 new deaths (Ituri 26, Nord-Kivu 6, Haut-Uele 2) take the DRC cumulative cleanly to 2536 confirmed / 1033 deaths (CFR 40.7%) with no harmonization this cycle (2473 + 63; 999 + 34). New confirmations rose 50 -> 63 while deaths rose only 32 -> 34, so the day's death-to-case ratio fell to 0.54 from 0.64. Deaths and confirmations of the same day are not the same cohort, so this is a reporting-ratio movement and NOT a case-fatality estimate; the cumulative CFR moved 40.4% -> 40.7%. Laboratory positives (46 + 12 + 5 = 63) equal the day's confirmations exactly, now across three reporting provinces. Tableau 1 prints a Total of 2531 that disagrees with its own province rows (which sum to 2536) and with Tableau 2 and the headline; 2536 is promoted.

text: National contact follow-up fell to 77.2% (10765/13936) from 82.0%, and this cycle the fall is a GENUINE deterioration in the epicentre rather than a composition effect: Ituri dropped 81.8% -> 75.4% while Nord-Kivu held flat (81.9% -> 81.7%) and the reporting composition was unchanged from last cycle. The source itself flags the Ituri decline for investigation. The same epicentre pattern runs through alert investigation, where the national rate stayed high at 87.4% while Ituri fell again, 72.8% -> 66.7%, leaving 166 alerts uninvestigated; the national figure is carried by Nord-Kivu's 98.8% (902/913) on a much larger volume.

text: 17 of the day's 34 confirmed deaths were community deaths detected by post-mortem swab (50.0%; Ituri 10 of 26, 38.5%), against 17 in-CTE deaths.
